mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT m.perms FROM infra_menu m INNER JOIN infra_role_menu rm ON rm.menu_id = m.id AND rm.is_delete = 0 INNER JOIN infra_role r ON r.id = rm.role_id AND r.is_delete = 0 AND r.status = 0 INNER JOIN infra_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = r.id AND ur.is_delete = 0 WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND m.is_delete = 0 AND m.status = 0 AND m.perms != ''

SELECT DISTINCT m.id, m.parent_id, m.name, m.type, m.path, m.component, m.perms, m.icon, m.sort, m.visible, m.status FROM infra_menu m INNER JOIN infra_role_menu rm ON rm.menu_id = m.id AND rm.is_delete = 0 INNER JOIN infra_role r ON r.id = rm.role_id AND r.is_delete = 0 AND r.status = 0 INNER JOIN infra_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = r.id AND ur.is_delete = 0 WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND m.is_delete = 0 AND m.status = 0 AND m.type IN (1, 2) ORDER BY m.sort ASC, m.id ASC
